title: Exploited GPUStack authentication bypass grants remote administrator access
summary: GPUStack trusts loopback request sources by default. A same-host proxy or forged real-IP header can grant unauthenticated administrator access, secret disclosure and worker code execution.

severity.rationale: CISA lists this flaw as exploited, and administrator access reaches secrets and code execution. Confirmed exploitation warrants action within 24 hours.

exposure: Exposed APIs with force_auth_localhost disabled can trust proxy peers or a forged X-GPUStack-Real-IP header as loopback.

remediation.details: Upgrade to 2.2.0 or later. Until then, require force_auth_localhost=true, strip client-supplied real-IP headers and restrict API access as the advisory recommends.
remediation.risk: Medium. Updating or containment can interrupt dependent workflows.

verification: Confirm the installed and running component meets the documented fix or containment condition.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted for independent review.

exploitation.note: CISA added the flaw on November 9, 2026.
